name: Whisper Small multilingual speech transcription
license: MIT (Whisper code and weights; Systran CTranslate2 conversion repository also declares MIT)
inference_mode: local CPU inference using faster-whisper with int8 compute; audio is not sent to a transcription API
languages_supported: multilingual; English, Hindi and Bengali hints are supported
limits_and_biases: Accuracy varies with accent, noise, microphone quality, and domain vocabulary.
The model is downloaded from Hugging Face on first transcription and requires network access once.
Uploaded audio is held temporarily on the backend for decoding and deleted after the request.
intended_use: Local transcription of user-recorded farmer questions; users should review the transcript before submitting it.
